fusions.name: Barnyard Stampede
fusions.desc: Sends a stampede through a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to everything in it. If it hits, every ally strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Kicked Pail
fusions.desc: Kicks a milk pail at the first enemy in line for 4 damage, with a 20% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Trough Break
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Slow to Rile
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
